description: Higher-risk trading with lower confidence requirements and aggressive position sizing

position_sizing.description: 15% base position, up to 40% per trade using Kelly criterion

risk_management.description: Wider stops (2.0x ATR), 4:1 reward-risk ratio for big wins

portfolio_allocation.description: Max 85% equity, min 5% cash, concentrate in 3+ assets

market_conditions.description: Trade in all conditions, avoid extreme volatility >50%

rebalancing.description: Rebalance quarterly or when allocations drift 15%
